== Trivia == *If player equips more than one Balloon Hat, only one of them will give stat bonus, resulting in only {{Green|+1}} {{stat|mf}} bonus. *Hatcessories are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2025/June 11|link=none|[[File:Red 6th Anniversary Balloon Hat.png|26px]] Added '''6th Anniversary Balloon Hat'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Accessories}} {{Nav/Armors}}
